_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Written for Raptor.
name: SFTPGo
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: SFTPGo is an SFTP and WebDAV server with a web admin and a web client for its users. The egg runs it on SQLite, with the web interface on the server's port and an admin account made on the first start.
startup: if [ ! -f sftpgo.db ] && [ -z "${SFTPGO_DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then echo "Set Admin password in the server's settings, then start the server again."; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p data; export SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__CREATE_DEFAULT_ADMIN=true SFTPGO_DATA_PROVIDER__USERS_BASE_DIR=/home/container/data SFTPGO_HTTPD__BINDINGS__0__PORT={{SERVER_PORT}} SFTPGO_SFTPD__BINDINGS__0__PORT={{SFTP_PORT}} SFTPGO_WEBDAVD__BINDINGS__0__PORT={{WEBDAV_PORT}}; exec ./sftpgo serve --config-dir /home/container --log-file-path "" --log-level info

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# SFTPGo: downloads SFTPGo from its GitHub releases, checked against
# GitHub's SHA-256. The users' files (data), the database, the host keys
# and sftpgo.json are never touched once there.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) arch=x86_64 ;;
    aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
    *) fail "SFTPGo has no build for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac

version="${VERSION:-latest}"
[ "$version" = latest ] || version="v${version#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag drakkan/sftpgo "$version") ||
    fail "Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.7.6, then reinstall."

if [ -x sftpgo ] && [ -d templates ] && [ "$(cat .sftpgo-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ]; then
    echo "SFTPGo $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading SFTPGo $tag."
    gh-release download drakkan/sftpgo "$tag" "sftpgo_${tag}_linux_${arch}.tar.xz" "$work/sftpgo.tar.xz"
    mkdir "$work/new"
    tar -xJf "$work/sftpgo.tar.xz" -C "$work/new" sftpgo sftpgo.json templates static openapi
    # The web interface's files go with the binary: replace them together.
    for d in templates static openapi; do
        rm -rf "$d"
        mv "$work/new/$d" "$d"
    done
    install -m 0755 "$work/new/sftpgo" sftpgo.new
    mv -f sftpgo.new sftpgo
    [ -f sftpgo.json ] || mv "$work/new/sftpgo.json" sftpgo.json
    echo "$tag" > .sftpgo-version
fi
mkdir -p data
echo "Installed SFTPGo $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The SFTPGo version to install, such as 2.7.6, or latest. Reinstall to change it.

variables.name: SFTP port
variables.description: The port SFTP listens on. Add it to the server's ports too.

variables.name: WebDAV port
variables.description: The port WebDAV listens on, or 0 to turn WebDAV off. Add it to the server's ports too.

variables.name: Admin username
variables.description: The name of the admin account made on the first start.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The admin account's password, needed for the first start. Change it later in the web admin.
